snippet.title: Scrap Mechanic: 1.0 & Drilling Thunder - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The new chapter is coming!
Get ready for Scrap Mechanic: 1.0 & Drilling Thunder! 
Coming July 24th 2026!

Years in the making, this monumental release 
comes packed with brand new content for the survival experience, 
alongside a big graphical upgrade!

Get Scrap Mechanic on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/387990/Scrap_Mechanic/

Enter the creative paradise of Scrap Mechanic! Build fantastic machines, go on adventures with your friends and defend against waves of evil Farmbots in this imaginative multiplayer survival sandbox. With Scrap Mechanic's powerful creation tools you can engineer your own adventures!

www.axolotgames.com
